name: Creech AFB
description: Creech AFB is the hub of Air Force remotely piloted aircraft (RPA) operations, hosting MQ-9 Reaper training and operations for global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Bldg 3)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access on US 95. Visitor Control Center co-located at Main Gate.

gates.name: East Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access east of Indian Springs. After-hours visitor passes at gate when VCC closed.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Main Gate)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1400; closed Sat-Sun and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 702-404-3694.

resources.name: Guardian Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting RPA operations with N'Rich Grill, deli, pizza, salad bar, and Simply To Go. Midnight meal available.
resources.address: Voodoo Rd, Bldg 1210, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Northside Shoppette (Mini BX)
resources.description: Limited Exchange shoppette. Full BX services available at Nellis AFB (30 miles).
resources.address: Firebee Rd, Bldg 1205, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Nevada Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Predator Fitness Center (Northside)
resources.description: Main fitness facility. Register CAC at front desk during manned hours for 24/7 access.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0730-1630; 24/7 CAC access after registration and SOU signature
resources.address: Viper Rd, Bldg 1204, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Reaper Fitness Center (Southside)
resources.description: Secondary fitness facility. Register at Northside during manned hours; receive access code for 24/7 entry (no CAC registry).
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri 0730-1630; 24/7 access code after registration at Northside

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for RPA personnel.
resources.address: Bldg 24, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Nellis Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: No on-base lodging at Creech. Official temporary lodging at Nellis AFB (30 miles). Reservations required.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, and family programs. Closed first Friday of month for training.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1530; closed first Friday of month, federal holidays, ACC/15 AF Family Days
resources.address: Bldg 24, 2nd Floor, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: 432nd Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, and family support programs for RPA operations.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website
resources.address: Bldg 24, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: 432nd Medical Group Clinic
resources.description: Ambulatory clinic for primary care and TRICARE services. Urgent care via Nellis or local ER.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.
resources.address: Bldg 24, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, and personnel actions.
resources.address: Bldg 24, 1065 Perimeter Rd, Creech AFB, NV 89018

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (Satellite Office)
resources.description: Equipment rental by appointment, RV storage, vehicle resale lot. Full ODR services via Nellis.

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access. REAL ID required.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1400; after-hours at Main Gate with sponsor
resources.address: Main Gate, Bldg 3, Creech AFB, NV 89018

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Main Gate)
primaryAction.address: Main Gate, Bldg 3, Creech AFB, NV 89018

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival. No on-base lodging — reserve Nellis Inn (702-652-2711) before arrival. Visit MPF within required timelines.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: No on-base lodging at Creech. Contact Nellis Inn for temporary lodging. Dormitory Management (702-404-1752) for unaccompanied housing.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 702-404-0864 if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 432 FSS, M&FRC, and Nellis 99 FSS for expanded MWR services.
